name: Connection and schedules
whenToUse: Connecting, onboarding or reconciling saved schedules.
instructions:
Connection setup is lightweight automation configuration, not a job-search run. For a connect/reconnect/setup request, discover tools, call read_onboarding_state and submit update_onboarding_step with event connection_test, current expectedRevision, a stable eventKey and empty data. The result contains automationSetup.schedule and connectionId. Do not follow the onboarding next-search prompt during connection setup. Read only this saved automation list; do not load career guides, personal resumes, browse jobs, import data, claim queued tasks or execute searches now. If schedule.enabled is true, configure its enabled mode=scheduled routines assigned to this connection in your runtime automation settings, using their saved time, timezone and description. Preserve unrelated runtime automations; find/update matching Lookout task IDs instead of duplicating on reconnect. Disabled/manual/unassigned tasks stay unstarted. Use Lookout task IDs as stable runtime identifiers; retain configVersion and schedule timezone. A scheduled run should read current task/context before executing, not bake private context into setup. This user setup request authorizes registering these saved schedules, not immediate task execution, submissions, sharing or messages beyond the setup report. Verify actual scheduler tool receipts; report configured task names, schedule IDs and next-run times when supplied, or the concrete missing capability/timezone/assignment. Never invent schedules, assume defaults are enabled, or report setup as activated from a preference save alone. If no enabled assigned schedules exist, say so and stop. If your runtime has no automation-settings capability, report that once and stop; do not install a scheduler or research workarounds. Give a brief setup summary, then end the turn. Broader search/import work requires a separate user request or an actual scheduled invocation.

Website setup completion is data.websiteCompletedAt, separate from agent readiness. Only the signed-in human can submit website_complete; direct the user to finish the website when needed. Only when the user separately requests search or an authorized scheduled run begins, read_onboarding_state before a questionnaire. Follow its server prompt through update_onboarding_step. Confirm actual browsing access in runtime, ask only the minimum search intent, then search real sources and publish one verified canonical employer job with evidence. Fit is preliminary without verified profile evidence. Submit first_match with data {jobId,sourceUrl,available:true,checkedAt,evidence,fit}. Use the jobId from an owned published batch item, not a search listing or screening ID; sourceUrl must exactly match its HTTPS canonical_url. available must be boolean true, not a field named availability. checkedAt must be no older than 24 hours and no more than 1 minute ahead of server time; evidence must contain 10-2000 trimmed characters and fit 5-2000. Published, archived or screened records do not replace fresh browsing evidence. Ask recommend, prepare, or auto_apply_requested only after that result. Import resumes only when needed; human verification and exact-answer authorization remain separate. Auto-apply requested never enables submission. Queue bounded tasks and poll read_agent_tasks only during separately requested work or actual scheduled runs; claim before working and report actual outcomes. Muse push, managed-agent runtime and scheduler activation are not verified: report concrete blockers and never claim a queued job, webhook acknowledgment, requested schedule, or conversational assent completed work. Respect revision/idempotency keys, preserve privacy, and keep social sharing off. Website and Circles are optional after first value.

Card pack widgets in preferences.theme.cardPacks link by taskId to My Agent tasks in preferences.search.schedule.routines. Tasks own instructions (description), sourceIds, connectionIds and mode (manual or scheduled). Read current settings before saving with save_notification_preferences (increment schedule.configVersion) and save_theme_preferences (increment cardPacksVersion); preserve unrelated settings and use exact expectedUpdatedAt. Saving timing does not start a scheduler. Only an assigned active connection with batches:write may publish_batch to an enabled task and pack. Each item needs recommendation.cardPackId and sourceId; private notes and analysis remain in recommendation. One pack per batch, stable eventKey, verified canonical jobs, actual observation date. Backend records publisherConnectionId and automationTaskId. Never invent source access, activate a recurring schedule, send messages or submit applications from a pack request.

For schedule_changed, call read_agent_schedule and reconcile enabled scheduled routines assigned to this connection against the actual runtime scheduler using stable Lookout task IDs, timezone and configVersion. Stop stale registrations for disabled, removed or unassigned routines; preserve unrelated automations. Verify real scheduler receipts before acknowledgement. If reconciliation is unavailable or fails, leave the event pending. A schedule-only wake does not load full personal/developer context, start tasks or advance personalVersion. The next authorized work run still checks all context versions.
